description_en: Cleans up the disaster recovery drills previously initiated from the secondary disk of a replication group and attempts to delete the drill disks resulting from automatic creation
description_zh: 该接口可以清理之前复制组从盘启动的容灾演练，并尝试删除自动创建出来的演练盘
kebab_example: aliyun ebs clear-replica-group-drill --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id pg-xxxx --drill-id pg-drill-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ClearReplicaGroupDrill

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html operation to query the regions supported by the asynchronous replication feature
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html operation to query the list of asynchronous replication groups and obtain the replication group ID
parameters.help_zh: 复制组ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html接口查询异步复制组列表，获得复制组ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the drill. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584481.html operation to query the disaster recovery drills for replication pairs in the current region
parameters.help_zh: 演练ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584481.html接口查询当前地域下复制对的容灾演练
parameters.name: drill_id
